markers.title: A Friend Like This
markers.description:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938982)

**How to Start:** Read the Note for Ambrus, found on his corpse, or a note in Bakir's treasure room. 

**Tips:**
- During the interrogation, mention your family for a peaceful resolution.

**Reward:**
- XP

markers.title: A Study in Crimson
markers.description:
**How to Start:** Pick up the pendant next to the skeleton, or visit a shop in Svartrau.

**Tips:**
- Eli's key opens the chest beneath the basement stairs.
- Simeon's key opens a chest on the top floor of the warehouse.

**Reward:**
- XP
- Skill Point
- Mercenary's Amulet
- [Vicho](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941686) becomes a Witchcraft Vendor

markers.title: Ambrus's Prisoners: Lucky Crossing
markers.description:
**How to Start:** Approach the group of prisoners. Note that they move around, so may not be in this exact spot.

**Tips:**
- Be ready to fight some soldiers.
- Visit Ursul to complete the quest.

**Reward:**
- XP
- Skill Point
